scope: All three frozen citation-bearing claims, all four ordinary body-flow citation keys, exact source passages, bibliographic identities, natural bibliography coverage, canonical TeX/BibTeX consistency, the active user-library binding, and the manuscript's finite-accounting assertions were checked; no unrestricted priority claim is certified.
citation_audit_method: Two-stage citation-check-skill search verification: freeze complete claim/citation extraction, then serially inspect the Springer publisher record, arXiv v1 full text and bibliography, the live official GitHub repository, and the primary Preprints.org full text; followed by official-metadata BibTeX comparison, exact local verifier replay, and AUX/BBL/log consistency checks. Serial verification was required because this bounded job prohibited agents and other workers.
